svg.title: Proof. All basis matrices except I are traceless, so the candidates have trace one. Expand (10) on (6), writing qaj = P μ gμxaμxjμ. The constant and a terms give (1 −rqaj)Rj/3; the b and ab terms give (1 −rqaj)(uAb + wCbj)/3. This is T λ ajSbj, proving the update. Summing the trace of the maps on the basis yields trace preservation: the I/3 traces sum to one, the A traces vanish because P j xj = 0, and the B, C images are traceless. Summing Φj(I/3) = Rj/3 gives I/3, proving stationarity. The first output j has probability 1/3 and leaves state Rj. A direct application gives Φk(Rj) = Sjk/3, so the second output is independent uniform and leaves Sjk. Every later update is (11); induction proves all finite words. This does not infer temporal independence from a reset: it uses the explicitly specified CP instrument at every step. Finally (3) gives the matching dimension-three lower bound.
